run_check_connected: run a script that checks if a Pyro4 named object is reachable via a nameserver
run_check_connected_exit_code: run the connectivity check and exit 0 on success or 1 on communication error
test_check_connected: test the Pyro4 connectivity checker by providing an object name and nameserver address
review_check_connected: review the Pyro4 connectivity check script that validates remote object reachability
summarize_check_connected: summarize the script that uses Pyro4.Proxy to bind and verify remote object connectivity
